Register a custom statistical lint rule

Source: R/lint-rules.R
register_stat_rule.Rd

Adds a statci_rule created with new_stat_rule() to the active statci rule registry so that subsequent calls to stat_lint() and stat_lint_dir() include it automatically.

Usage

register_stat_rule(rule, overwrite = FALSE)

Arguments

rule

A statci_rule object created by new_stat_rule().

overwrite

Logical; if TRUE, allows replacing an existing rule with the same id.

Value

Invisibly returns rule.

Examples

r <- new_stat_rule(
  id = "demo_rule",
  title = "Demo rule",
  severity = "info",
  check = function(ctx) list()
)
register_stat_rule(r)
"demo_rule" %in% list_stat_rules()$id
#> [1] TRUE
unregister_stat_rule("demo_rule")
